column1: # Where a row goes when its family states no placement of its own, and who its audience then is.
# Read by tools/build_family_model.py. Every quote stands verbatim in the cited section.
# default: the placements a family's rows may take and who chooses among them. A placement cell the census leaves to the signer takes it.
# scope: the audience of one cohort_scope and what a node outside it learns, each quoting its line of the CC 5.2 table. The seven scopes appear once each.
#   public_room yes marks the line for a community that is a public room: the audience is the same, and more is read on request.
# reach: who a row reaches because it names them. moves: when a row within a peer's audience moves to that peer.
# copy: whose audience a row joins because another row names it.

column8: Scope is per-row; a family is not scope-pinned.

column6: nothing, not even that the content exists
column8: | `self` | the owner's own nodes | nothing, not even that the content exists |

column5: the nodes of the family's current members
column6: nothing, not even that the content exists
column8: | `family` | the nodes of the family's current members | nothing, not even that the content exists |

column5: the claimed nodes of the roster's members
column6: nothing of the content, of the roster or of who holds it
column8: | `community`, `affiliations` | the claimed nodes of the roster's members | nothing of the content, of the roster or of who holds it |

column5: the claimed nodes of the roster's members
column6: the listing, the holding claims and, by asking a member's node, the content and the roster
column8: | `community`, in a public room ([CC 3.2](part_3_the_namespace.md#3.2)) | the claimed nodes of the roster's members | the listing, the holding claims and, by asking a member's node, the content and the roster |

column6: everything: the holding claims here are the holder directory
column8: | `species`, `biosphere`, `federation` (the Commons) | every node | everything: the holding claims here are the holder directory ([CC 3.1.3.3](part_3_the_namespace.md#3.1.3.3)) |

column5: a row that names a node is always served to that node
column8: A row that names a node, or a grant issued for it, is always served to that node

column5: at family, community or affiliations a row may name only keys within its audience
column8: A row placed at `family`, `community` or `affiliations` may name only keys within its audience

column5: the row may be served to a node, not that it is sent
column8: Being in a row's audience means the row may be served to a node, not that it is sent.

column5: the peer itself pulls for a subject or a dimension
column8: | requested | the peer itself pulls for a subject or a dimension ([CC 5.3.2.4.4](#5.3.2.4.4)); an automatic diff is not a request |

column5: the peer must hold it to seal, address and take part
column8: | required | the peer must hold it to seal, address and take part: the consent-free set of [CC 5.4.6](#5.4.6) and the rows of the cohorts it belongs to |
| appropriate | its audience names the peer: it is addressed to the peer, is about it, or is placed in a cohort it is in,

column5: a row's audience includes that of a concluded row naming it from the same room, or signed by the same key, whose signer is already in its audience
column8: A row carries its audience to the rows it names, when it is concluded, sits in the same room as the row it names, and its signer is already in that row's audience.
